vulnerabilities.evidence_snippet: uint oCredit = credit[msg.sender]; if (oCredit > 0) { balance -= oCredit; bool callResult = msg.sender.call.value(oCredit)(); require(callResult); credit[msg.sender] = 0; }

execution.state_issue: balance not updated before external function call
execution.exploitable_behavior: external function can be triggered after state change

causality.state: credit[msg.sender] is accessed and balance is decremented but not yet updated in the external function call
causality.transition: external function called without proper synchronization with balance update
causality.capability: attacker can cause external function to fail after state change
causality.outcome: balance may be incorrectly updated or external function may fail
